KnowledgeCoverage.description: Conservative interpretation limits, independent of the delivered hit population.

declaration_locations.description: Registry declaration definition locations are not fabricated.

excerpt_attribution.description: Text matches only subjects explicitly attributed by original owners.

producer_freshness.description: Producer fingerprints are not a live freshness attestation.

undeclared_relationships.description: Missing semantic links are not inferred from prose or topics.

oneOf.description: Exact subject conjunction, optionally narrowed by attributed text.

NativeExplanationIdentity.description: Source-owned context for one exact selected native query. Unknown supplier facts stay absent.

data_cut.description: Exact generation/revision/continuation selection supplied by the query owner.

issuer.description: Issuer from the same admitted store, not a caller's display alias.

server_invocation.description: Original physical server invocation when supplied by its owner.

server_recipe.description: Exact prepared recipe when the physical owner supplies it.

server_version.description: Actual supplied server version; an unobserved version is unknown.

NativeExplanationResponse.description: Original complete response facts. Durations are never combined with caller-side clocks.

kind.description: Whether these facts describe EXPLAIN inspection or the explicitly profiled operation.

statements.description: Supplied per-statement facts, retaining statement positions and absent durations.

NativeExplanationResponseKind.description: Distinguish passive inspection work from executing the selected profiled operation.

oneOf.description: Original response to a nonexecuting EXPLAIN inspection.
Original response to an explicitly admitted EXPLAIN ANALYZE operation.

NativeExplanationStatement.description: Facts from one original response slot.

database_execution_ns.description: Supplied database execution time only, in nanoseconds; absent remains unknown.

succeeded.description: Original statement status, not inferred from a plan or output count.

NativeQueryExplanation.description: Bounded projection of a selected query and supplier facts, not a permanent supplier plan schema.

analyzed.description: True only for explicitly admitted ANALYZE; ordinary inspection does not execute the query.

identity.description: Selected issuer, cut and available incarnation facts.

observations.description: Bounded supplier operator observations with missing counters omitted.

query.description: Actual checked source query description and bindings used by this owner.

response.description: Complete original inspection/profile response, when actually received.

description: Nonexecuting versioned plan envelope; optimizer plan contents are opaque version-specific data.

explanation.description: Common source-owned identity, selected native query and original inspection statistics.

freshness.description: This read does not reopen original source files.

raw_plan_json.description: Raw informational optimizer output, not a stable query grammar.
